title: CLAUDE.md Quest Workflow block names a skill path that does not exist and runs the overview on every request
description: OPAG-378 item 5, raised by opum-agent as a tier-2 fact, not an instruction; the owner chose the fix directly on 2026-09-23. The hand-written QUEST GUIDELINES block points at .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md, which is absent: the skill is installed from the opum-quest plugin, and skills/quest/SKILL.md is its source here. It also requires `quest instructions overview` (4,237 bytes, about 1k tokens) before every request, including requests that never touch the tracker. After QCLI-362 the managed block names that guide itself.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The skill line names the opum-quest plugin skill (source: skills/quest/SKILL.md), not the absent .claude path
The overview rule is scoped to once per session, before the first tracker action, rather than every request
Only the hand-written QUEST GUIDELINES block changes; the managed quest block still passes agents --check

finalSummary:
Two corrections to the hand-written QUEST GUIDELINES block in CLAUDE.md. opum-agent raised this as OPAG-378 item 5, a tier-2 fact about my own governing file. The repository owner chose this fix directly on 2026-09-23, from a two-option ask.

1. The skill line named .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md, which does not exist. It now names opum-quest:quest from the plugin, with skills/quest/SKILL.md as its source here. The installed opum-quest 0.7.1 copy is byte-identical to that file.
2. The every-request overview rule is now once per session, before the first tracker action, and re-run after a quest upgrade. The overview guide is 4,237 bytes.

Overlap, checked at the owner request:
- The skill (1,144 bytes) is a pointer to --list, overview and help, so it shares no content with the overview; it routes to it.
- The overview has the unique content: the command list, the exit codes, and the envelope shape with the record under data.
- The real duplication is between this hand-written block and the QCLI-362 managed block. Both now list the guides and the actor flags. Trimming that is left to the owner.

Verification: the diff touches only the hand-written block (8+/2-); agents --check --require-installed --target claude reports current; lore check exits 0.
